Collection of commands to support the creation and management of Algorand node instances, where each instance corresponds to a unique data directory.

Usage:
  goal node [flags]
  goal node [command]

Available Commands:
  catchup        Catchup the Algorand node to a specific catchpoint
  clone          Clone the specified node to create another node
  create         Create a node at the desired data directory for the desired network
  generate-p2pid Generate a new p2p private key
  generatetoken  Generate and install a new API token
  lastround      Print the last round number
  pendingtxns    Get a snapshot of current pending transactions on this node
  restart        Stop, and then start, the specified Algorand node
  start          Initialize the specified Algorand node
  status         Get the current node status
  stop           Stop the specified Algorand node
  wait           Waits for the node to make progress

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for node

Global Flags:
  -d, --datadir stringArray   Data directory for the node
  -k, --kmddir string         Data directory for kmd

Use "goal node [command] --help" for more information about a command.
